metas.name: South Park
metas.description: The misadventures of four foul-mouthed, dirty-minded, irreverent grade-schoolers who live in the quiet, dysfunctional mountain town of South Park, Colorado.

metas.name: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners
metas.description: A Street Kid trying to survive in a technology and body modification-obsessed city of the future. Having everything to lose, he chooses to stay alive by becoming an Edgerunner, a Mercenary outlaw also known as a Cyberpunk.

metas.name: Percy Jackson and the Olympians
metas.description: Demigod Percy Jackson leads a quest across America to prevent a war among the Olympian gods.

metas.name: Rick and Morty

metas.name: The Simpsons

metas.name: Jujutsu Kaisen

metas.name: Invincible
metas.description: When 17-year-old Mark Grayson inherits superpowers, he becomes the superhero Invincible.

metas.name: Avatar: The Last Airbender

metas.name: Family Guy
metas.description: In a wacky Rhode Island town, a dysfunctional family strives to cope with everyday life as they are thrown from one crazy scenario to another.

metas.name: Heartland

metas.name: Arcane
metas.description: Amid the stark discord of twin cities Piltover and Zaun, two sisters fight on rival sides of a war between magic technologies and clashing convictions.

metas.name: The Middle
metas.description: The daily mishaps of a married woman and her semi-dysfunctional family and their attempts to survive life in general in the town of Orson, Indiana.

metas.name: Vinland Saga

metas.name: BoJack Horseman

metas.name: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood

metas.name: Bob's Burgers

metas.name: Malcolm in the Middle

metas.name: SpongeBob SquarePants

metas.name: Love, Death & Robots

metas.name: Naruto

metas.name: Gravity Falls

metas.name: Get Jiro!

metas.name: Star Wars: The Clone Wars

metas.name: Castlevania

metas.name: Solar Opposites

metas.name: Justice League

metas.name: Man vs Baby
